from collections import deque
h,w=15,5
zeros=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==0)

    q=deque([c]); comp=set()
    while q:

        if x in seen: continue
        seen.add(x); comp.add(x)

            if y in zeros and y not in seen: q.append(y)
    comps.append(comp)
for c in comps:
    border=any(i==0 or i==h-1 or j==0 or j==w-1 for i,j in c)
    print(len(c), border, sorted(c)[:12])

from collections import deque
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    z={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==0}
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for c in z:
        if c in seen: continue
        q=deque([c]); cp=set()
        while q:
            x=q.popleft()
            if x in seen: continue
            seen.add(x); cp.add(x)
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                y=(x[0]+di,x[1]+dj)
                if y in z and y not in seen: q.append(y)
        comps.append(cp)
    if not comps: return g
    mx=max(comps,key=len); mn=min(comps,key=len)
    for i,j in mx: g[i][j]=8
    for i,j in mn: g[i][j]=7
    return g
# verify demos

assert transform(i2)==o2, 'demo2 fail'
